name: VIS
recent: Visdynamics 在截至 2026 年 7 月 31 日的季度录得营收 1235.4 万令吉、净利 376.4 万令吉，营收环比增长 91.1%、同比增长 57.5%，净利环比增长 496.5%、同比增长 294.5%。同期，公司因员工行使 ESOS 期权而发行 142.6 万股新股，并于 2026 年 11 月 3 日上市。此外，董事及主要管理人员在 10 月至 11 月间有多笔凭单和股份的买卖申报。
notable: 截至 2026 年 7 月 31 日季度净利 376.4 万令吉，营收 1235.4 万令吉，环比和同比均大幅增长。
因员工行使 ESOS 期权，公司发行 142.6 万股新股，发行价每股 0.42 令吉，新股于 2026 年 11 月 3 日上市。
董事及主要管理人员在 10 月至 11 月间有多笔凭单和股份的买卖申报。
risks: 执行董事 Chan Heng Soon 于 2026 年 10 月 6 日申报 disposal 265,000 张凭单 C 2023/2028。
主要管理人员 Teo Leong Khoon 于 2026 年 10 月 7 日申报 disposal 300,000 张凭单 C 2023/2028。
主要管理人员 Chong Wen Tat 于 2026 年 10 月 6 日申报 disposal 50,000 股普通股。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 7 月 31 日季度，营收为 1235.4 万令吉，环比增长 91.1%，同比增长 57.5%；净利为 376.4 万令吉，环比增长 496.5%，同比增长 294.5%；净利率为 30.5%，高于上一季度的 9.8%。

recent_en: Visdynamics reported revenue of RM12.354 million and net profit of RM3.764 million for the quarter ended 31 July 2026, with revenue up 91.1% QoQ and 57.5% YoY, and net profit up 496.5% QoQ and 294.5% YoY. During the period, the company issued 1,426,000 new shares under its ESOS following option exercises, listed on 3 November 2026. In addition, there were several announcements of warrant and share dealings by directors and principal officers between October and November.
notable_en: Net profit of RM3.764 million and revenue of RM12.354 million for the quarter ended 31 July 2026, with significant growth both QoQ and YoY.
The company issued 1,426,000 new shares under its ESOS at RM0.42 per share following option exercises, with the new shares listed on 3 November 2026.
Several announcements of warrant and share dealings by directors and principal officers between October and November.
risks_en: Executive Director Chan Heng Soon reported disposal of 265,000 Warrants C 2023/2028 on 6 October 2026.
Principal Officer Teo Leong Khoon reported disposal of 300,000 Warrants C 2023/2028 on 7 October 2026.
Principal Officer Chong Wen Tat reported disposal of 50,000 ordinary shares on 6 October 2026.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 31 July 2026, revenue was RM12.354 million, up 91.1% QoQ and 57.5% YoY; net profit was RM3.764 million, up 496.5% QoQ and 294.5% YoY; net margin was 30.5%, higher than 9.8% in the previous quarter.
